title: 面向韧性制造供应链的技能约束模型预测控制
summary: 提出一种技能约束的模型预测控制器，通过有限时域混合整数规划优化生产、库存、积压和培训决策，以应对技能瓶颈、需求冲击等扰动。实验表明，预测控制仅在技能瓶颈可提前预测时优于静态保险策略，否则静态策略更优。
summary_en: Proposes a skill-constrained model predictive controller that optimizes production, inventory, backlog, and training via finite-horizon mixed-integer programming. Experiments show predictive control outperforms static insurance only when skill bottlenecks are forecastable; otherwise, static strategies are more robust.
